# Fun Factory Play Café

> Indoor playground, birthday party venue, and family café in Pickering, Ontario, Canada.

## Canonical website
https://funfactoryplay.ca

## Business summary
Fun Factory Play Café (also known as The Fun Factory Indoor Playground and Party Centre) is a socks-only indoor play facility for children and families at 1420 Bayly St., Unit 15, Pickering, ON L1W 3R4, Canada.

Families visit for unlimited drop-in play (pay at the front desk), multi-level play structures, a dedicated toddler area, birthday party packages with private party rooms, and Littles & Lattés Café for coffee and snacks.

## Contact
- Phone: (647) 824-8389
- Email: info@funfactoryplay.ca
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/funfactoryplay/
- Littles & Lattés Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/littlesandlattess/

## Hours
- Friday–Sunday: 9:30 am – 8:30 pm
- Tuesday & Thursday: 3:30 pm – 7:30 pm (50% off drop-in admissions)
- Closed Monday and Wednesday

## Drop-in admissions (pay at desk, unlimited play time)
- Under 1 year old: $5.00 (free with paying sibling)
- Ages 1–3: $10.00
- Ages 4–13: $14.00
- Ages 14–17: $10.00

## Party packages (starting prices, CAD)
- Fun Party: $369 (10 kids, 10 adults)
- Active Fun Party: $459 (15 kids, 15 adults)
- Supreme Fun Party: $579 (20 kids, 20 adults)
- Extreme Fun Party: $719 (30 kids, 30 adults)
- Ultimate Fun Party: from $1,399 weekday / $1,999 weekend

## Important policies
- Socks required for children and adults (socks-only facility)
- Waiver required before entry
- Parent supervision required at all times
- Nut-free outside food allowed; no outside drinks
- Tuesday/Thursday 50% off drop-in visits do not earn loyalty points
